Administration
The County Administrator is the administrative head of the County and is responsible for the overall management of county operations and for carrying out all decisions, policies, ordinances, and resolutions of the Board of Commissioners.
Assessor
Discover the role of Brown County's assessors in property valuation, tax assessment, and maintaining precise property records essential for community governance.
Attorney
Discover the services of the Brown County Attorney's Office, providing legal representation, prosecutorial functions, and community legal support.
Auditor-Treasurer
Learn about the responsibilities of the Brown County Auditor-Treasurer, including financial management, tax collection, and maintaining accurate public records.
Community Corrections
To enhance public safety through the implementation of a balanced justice model which assists victims of crime and promotes positive behavior change in clients.
County Commissioner
Discover the roles and responsibilities of Brown County Commissioners, dedicated to effective governance and enhancing community welfare through strategic decision-making.
County Parks
The Brown County Park System includes a year-round park with campground and three seasonal, day-use parks.
Court Administration
Learn more information about Court Administration on this page.
Drainage
Explore Brown County's drainage systems and services, designed to manage water flow, prevent flooding, and maintain agricultural and urban land productivity.
Elections
Access information on elections in Brown County, including voting procedures, candidate details, and election results to ensure informed participation.
Emergency Management
Emergency Management
Highway
The Brown County Highway Department is required to perform a self-evaluation of its current transportation infrastructure policies, practices, and programs.
Human Resources
The Human Resources Department is responsible for a variety of personnel management functions related to employees and employment, including: all aspects of the employment process from recruitment to termination; implementation and administration of compensation and benefits programs; employee activities and employee counseling; monitoring compliance with the County's Personnel Policies and Regulations, collective bargaining agreements and federal and state employment laws.
Human Services
Working with many others, Brown County Human Services helps ensure that Brown County seniors, people with disabilities, children and others meet their basic needs and have the opportunity to reach their full potential.

Public Health

Recorder
The Mission of the Brown County Recorder's Office is to preserve and provide for the public a true and reliable, readily accessible, permanent account of real property and other official records and vital human events, both historic and current, and to do so with commitment, courtesy, and excellence.
Sheriff's Office
Learn more information about Sheriff's Office on this page.
Transit / Heartland Express
Brown County Heartland Express provides more than 50,000 rides each year in Brown County, including the cities of New Ulm, Sleepy Eye, Evan, Cobden, Springfield, Comfrey and Hanska.
Veterans Service Office (VSO)
It is our mission to provide assistance and support to veterans and their dependents in obtaining their rightful benefits through county, state, and federal programs and to act as an advocate on their behalf or direct them to other authorized agencies as their needs dictate.
